test_title: PYST 10: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 15th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Convert the sentence from passive to active: The suspect was thought to have taken refuge in the old warehouse.

options.text: Authorities believed the suspect had taken refuge in the old warehouse.
Someone doubted the suspect hid in the warehouse.
It was thought the suspect was hiding in the warehouse.
The suspect believed he was hiding in the warehouse.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 
**__Key Points__** 
 
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the passive voice sentence becomes the object of the active voice sentence. 
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The suspect was thought to have taken refuge in the old warehouse." 
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the implied subject "authorities" at the beginning. 
 
• Change the passive verb form "was thought" to "believed" i
